strings.koot.body:
Im Al-Koot-Viertel von Hofuf, direkt gegenüber Qasr Ibrahim, wohnen die Gäste in einem knapp zweihundert Jahre alten Palast, der zu einem Kulturerbe-Gasthaus restauriert wurde. Das 963 Quadratmeter große Gebäude folgt dem alten Hasawi-Baustil, dem Baustil Al-Ahsas, und wurde auf persönliche Initiative von Abdulaziz bin Mohammed Al-Abdulqader restauriert. Im Jahr 1439 n. H. (2018 n. Chr.) eröffneten es Prinz Sultan bin Salman und Prinz Saud bin Nayef. Es war im Gouvernorat das erste Kulturerbe-Hotel, das von der Kommission für Tourismus und Nationalerbe lizenziert wurde.

Die Zimmer umfassen acht Suiten unter Decken aus Palmstämmen und Palmwedeln, ihre Wände sind von gewölbten Nischen durchbrochen und mit Sadu-Gewebe (Webstoff) behängt. Im Eingangsbereich sind antike Stücke ausgestellt, und eine Bibliothek im Obergeschoss enthält Bücher in mehreren Sprachen über die Geschichte von Al-Ahsa und Al-Koot. Qasr Ibrahim liegt nur wenige Schritte von der Tür entfernt, und der Qaisariyah-Souk sowie der Al-Fawaris-Souk sind etwa einen halben Kilometer entfernt – ein Aufenthalt mitten in der historischen Stadt, nicht an ihrem Rand.

tm_pairs.en: In Hofuf's Al-Koot district, directly opposite Qasr Ibrahim, guests stay inside a palace close to two hundred years old that was restored into a heritage inn. The 963-square-metre building follows the old Hasawi architectural style, and was restored as a personal initiative by Abdulaziz bin Mohammed Al-Abdulqader. It opened in 1439 AH (2018 CE) at the hands of Prince Sultan bin Salman and Prince Saud bin Nayef, and was the first heritage hotel in the governorate to be licensed by the Saudi Commission for Tourism and National Heritage. The rooms are eight suites set beneath ceilings of palm trunks and fronds, their walls cut with arched niches and hung with sadu weaving. Antique pieces are displayed in the entrance hall, and an upper-floor library holds books on the history of Al-Ahsa and Al-Koot in several languages. Qasr Ibrahim stands a few steps from the door, and Qaisariyah Souq and Al-Fawaris Souq about half a kilometre away — a stay inside the historic city rather than on its edge.

notes:
Batch de-stay reviewed as stage-7 judge. The 01-05 pipeline had already resolved the largest fluency risks (sentence-clamp splitting, active voice) and stage 5's 10-point checklist passed clean; the blind reader's 18 observations caught second-order naturalness issues: an en/ar calque pattern ('ist beschreibend, keine Empfehlung' / 'einstufen ... ueber'), a genuine two-antecedent relative-pronoun ambiguity around 'Gouvernorat'/'Kulturerbe-Hotel' repeated twice on the page, an over-literary alt text, a sentence-opening bare year number, and smaller clarity nits (caravan site 'eigen', 'in mehreren Sprachen' placement, double 'einem'). All nine applied/partial fixes changed wording only - no fact, number, or termbase form was added, removed or overridden. Three observations were rejected because applying them would have broken an already-published cross-page German string (Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa / Caravanstellplatz; Kueste von Al-Uqair - oestlich von Al-Ahsa, both recorded in memory/tm.json) or invented a fact the source does not carry (a description of what sadu weaving is). Two observations (the free-floating 'Die erste Gruppe' eyebrow; the unstated Al-Uqair/Al-Ahsa administrative relationship) are logged as source_defects - both exist identically in en and ar and sit outside a translation stage's fence. One observation (no visible rating on the captured single-place page) is a build/data-rendering matter, not a wording defect, and was rejected as out of scope. The three termbase additions (Kulturerbe-Gasthaus, Al-Fawaris-Souk, Sadu-Gewebe) carry verbatim sourced witnesses (Duden + in-repo precedent) and are promoted unchanged from stage 4/5.

BINDING: The 'descriptive, not a recommendation' disclaimer must use a verb-led clause ('... beschreibt nur, ohne zu empfehlen'), never the calque 'ist beschreibend, keine Empfehlung' - applies to every card/FAQ/method-note page reusing this disclaimer, including restaurants ج6/ج7.
BINDING: For a short list of only two or a few sample items, write 'X und Y', never 'von X bis Y' (implies a spanning range) - same fix for any future short card list using this pattern.
BINDING: Alt text for photos must stay plain and functional, not literary; avoid stacking two decorative participles/adjectives ('zinnenbekroent' + 'davorliegend') in one alt string - prefer 'mit X und Y davor'.
